Front, oblique, side, rear, aerial, underside real consistent-geometry Blender renders
Low/mid/high internal views and floor-verified human view if geometrically appropriate
Two actual Blender sections showing inhabited urban depth and open void relation
Real visible macro editing based on image criticism, before/after exact BLEND and GLB
10km city context only as noncanonical composition with W0/H/SB obligations retained
GitHub research branch and Draft PR with raw art files, review and exact evidence

City mini houses stuck onto external macro sculpture
Same district shape copied at all elevations
Open white background mislabeled connected urban void
Polygons/bounds/CI success used as substitute for artistic acceptance
